data.body: AC amendment: Expand to one malformed fixture per SC-1 constraint class: (1) missing required field (dom_xpath absent), (2) wrong type (scores.intent_match: 'five'), (3) enum violation (bbox_confidence: 'unknown'), (4) integer out of range (scores.whitespace_balance: 6), (5) additionalProperties leak (extra spurious_field). Parametrize test with pytest.mark.parametrize. Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent.py -v -k 'malformed'
